rationale: ArcLight's current investments page lists Sequitur as a current renewable investment, and ArcLight's company-issued announcements expressly define Sequitur as Sequitur Renewables, LLC. The requested holding therefore maps to the existing Sequitur Renewables record rather than requiring a new company. The existing canonical identity, active status, 2022 investment year, Power & ET / Operating Wind Portfolio classification and U.S. geography remain list-level accurate. The required correction is to add the Sequitur alias, attribute the ownership to ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P., and replace the nonfactual vehicle value 'n.a.' with NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED because the immediate legal holding vehicle and numeric stake are not publicly disclosed.

The platform is the PortCo; the individual wind-farm entities, projects and any local acquisition vehicles beneath it are not separate PortCos.

operatingResolution.description: Sequitur Renewables is ArcLight's U.S. platform for acquiring and optimizing mature operating wind farms through operational, commercial and financial value-add initiatives. Its portfolio comprises five PJM wind facilities in Pennsylvania and West Virginia plus Diablo Wind in Alameda County, California.
operatingResolution.services: Ownership, operation and value optimization of mature operating wind farms, including operational, commercial and financial management.
operatingResolution.customersAndEndMarkets: Wholesale electricity and renewable-energy-credit markets; the initial portfolio sells power and renewable energy credits into the merchant PJM market, and the California asset operates in the Altamont Pass market footprint.
operatingResolution.footprint: Mountaineer Wind Energy Center / Backbone Mountain Windpower, Meyersdale Windpower, Mill Run Windpower, Somerset Windpower and Waymart Wind Farm in Pennsylvania and West Virginia, plus Diablo Wind in Alameda County, California.
operatingResolution.disclosedScale: 185 MW initial operating PJM portfolio, reported as 184.5 MW in FERC asset-level capacities, plus one operating Altamont Pass wind farm; ArcLight also announced 80 MWh of adjunct BESS development opportunities in 2022.

acquisitionExitCheck.initialInvestment: ArcLight announced on 2022-08-01 that Sequitur had signed an agreement with affiliates of GlidePath Power Solutions LLC to acquire five operating Pennsylvania and West Virginia wind farms totaling 185 MW; closing was then subject to conditions. FERC docket EC22-101 identified Backbone Mountain Windpower LLC, Meyersdale Windpower LLC, Mill Run Windpower LLC, Somerset Windpower LLC and Waymart Wind Farm LLC and was filed on 2022-08-11. FERC authorized the disposition on 2022-10-20, and a FERC asset-appendix report states that the transaction was consummated on 2022-10-31. PJM's 2022 market-monitor report lists 2022-10-30; the ownership ledger adopts FERC's 2022-10-31 date while retaining the one-day discrepancy as an unresolved noncritical point.
acquisitionExitCheck.californiaBoltOn: On 2023-05-16, ArcLight announced that Sequitur had acquired an operating wind farm in California's Altamont Pass region and expressly described it as another acquisition added to the Sequitur platform. Sequitur's official portfolio identifies its California holding as Diablo Wind in Alameda County. The seller, consideration, numeric stake and exact legal closing date are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED. This is a platform bolt-on asset, not a separate manager-level PortCo.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: Targeted searches for a Sequitur sale, exit, ownership change, rebrand, insolvency, dissolution or signed pending PortCo transaction through 2026-08-15 found none. ArcLight still lists Sequitur as Current, and Sequitur's official website remains active in 2026. DigitalBridge signed a pending agreement in May 2026 to acquire ArcLight at the manager level, conditioned on other transaction and regulatory steps; that agreement is not a disclosed transfer of Sequitur or Fund VII's portfolio interest and therefore is not entered as a Sequitur ownership transaction.
